model: ped movement assignment (which phases / ped overlaps each ped input calls)
decision: per ped input: every candidate movement with p >= threshold; none -> no_movement
augmentation: input-renumbered copy of every training row (each signal ped input numbers permuted; only same_number changes), weight 0.1
candidates: every ped input with presses (90) x every phase 1-16 with a 21 or 45 and every ped overlap 1-32 with a 67 or 68 at that signal in the window
labels: Kinetic Signals stored controller databases (2026-10-28 upload): active ped detector plan (plan 1; plan 3 at 13002-13005, polled live) call phase + additional phases / call overlap

accuracy.source: device-grouped 5-fold OOF over Sep + Oct 2026; exact = predicted set == configured set (movements with ped activity in the window)
